description: Skyfallskartering 2023, 100-årsregn, maxdjup(m) is a dataset listed in Sweden's data portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Samordning för hållbarhet, Ekonomi och hållbarhetsstyrning. Skyfall mapping for Mölndal's urban areas developed by the city administration, Mölndal's city. The skyfall map shows which areas are at risk of flooding in the event of heavy rain (100-year rain with a climate factor of 1.25). Coverage: Samordning för hållbarhet, Ekonomi och hållbarhetsstyrning. The portal shows the English title as "Skyfall map 2023, 100-year rain, maximum depth(m)" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Samordning för hållbarhet, Ekonomi och hållbarhetsstyrning. Its keywords include Översvämning, Samordning för hållbarhet, Ekonomi och hållbarhetsstyrning, Skyfall, Skyfallskartering. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-oppnadata.
